name: workspace
description: Set up and look after a shared agentic workspace: a first-time interview that makes the kit the team's own and checks it is reachable on every surface people use, a weekly tidy of where context lives, an audit of the register guidance is written in, and a session-start summary of what is out of step (git hooks, submodules, resources, the privacy of the remote), with a guard that keeps agents from bypassing the git hooks.
